# Soumtok

> Africa's #1 AI coding platform.

Soumtok is Africa's #1 AI coding platform — the cheapest powerful coding agent from $5 a month. Cursor-style agents in Studio, Desktop IDE, and Terminal CLI. Open Studio, attach a repo, pick a model, and ship.

## Product

- Studio chat with frontier models
- Soumtok Desktop — agent-first IDE for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Soumtok Terminal CLI — Cursor-style agent in your shell
- GitHub as the source of truth — agents open branches and pull requests
- Plugins, connectors, and skills
- Cloud agents that ship as pull requests

## Docs

- [Docs](https://soumtok.com/docs): Africa's #1 AI coding platform. Studio, GitHub, models, and how the desk works.
- [Quick start](https://soumtok.com/docs/quick-start): Create an account, finish onboarding, open Studio, and ship your first chat on Soumtok.
- [Accounts](https://soumtok.com/docs/accounts): Sign up with Google, GitHub, or email. Sessions, verification, and how Soumtok accounts work.
- [Handle & public profile](https://soumtok.com/docs/profile): Claim a handle people can find. Public profiles, reserved paths, and privacy on Soumtok.
- [Studio chat](https://soumtok.com/docs/studio): Studio is the desk. Attach GitHub, pick a model, add skills, and hand the work to the agent.
- [Models](https://soumtok.com/docs/models): DeepSeek, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and GPT in one picker. Bring your own keys when you want.
- [Codebase](https://soumtok.com/docs/codebase): Grant GitHub repos, attach a project to chat, and keep GitHub as the source of truth.
- [Automations](https://soumtok.com/docs/automations): Recurring Studio jobs on a repo — triggers, tools, and spend, without leaving Soumtok.
- [Cloud agents](https://soumtok.com/docs/agents): Cloud agents open a branch and a pull request on GitHub. The contract is a PR, not a zip.
- [Dashboard](https://soumtok.com/docs/dashboard): Overview, usage, members, billing, and the rest of the workspace around Studio.
- [GitHub](https://soumtok.com/docs/github): Connect the Soumtok GitHub App, grant repos, and let agents open pull requests.
- [Plugins](https://soumtok.com/docs/plugins): Install MCP plugins so Studio can talk to the tools you already use.
- [Connectors](https://soumtok.com/docs/connectors): Link Slack, Linear, Figma, and the rest. Soumtok talks to the stack you already pay for.
- [Skills](https://soumtok.com/docs/skills): Packaged instructions the agent can load. Built-in skills plus the ones you upload.
- [API keys](https://soumtok.com/docs/keys): Platform keys and bring-your-own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and xAI.
- [Billing](https://soumtok.com/docs/billing): Start $5, Pro $20, Pro Plus $48. Everyday vs Additional pools, M-Pesa and PayPal checkout, and how to read Spending.
- [Pricing & usage](https://soumtok.com/docs/pricing-usage): One meter for Studio and Desktop. Everyday vs Additional pools, Soumtok Agent free, images, BYOK, and on-demand.
- [Settings & security](https://soumtok.com/docs/settings): Profile, appearance, two-factor, sessions, and how Soumtok handles your account.
- [API](https://soumtok.com/docs/api): Auth, Studio, GitHub, and billing endpoints for the Soumtok HTTP API.
- [CLI & Terminal](https://soumtok.com/docs/cli): Install the Soumtok Terminal CLI for a Cursor-style agent in your shell. Download Desktop for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Plans](https://soumtok.com/docs/plans): Start $5, Pro $20, Pro Plus $48. Everyday models, dual pools, Soumtok Agent free, and upgrade path.
- [Company](https://soumtok.com/docs/company): Soumtok is built in Nairobi. Contact, GitHub org, and how we talk about the product.
